responsibility: This file implements the minimum-cost maximal-flow algorithm GCC uses to smooth inconsistent basic-block and edge profile counts. It builds a fixup graph from the CFG and sampled or estimated counts, computes maximal flow, repeatedly cancels negative-cost cycles in the residual network, and then adjusts CFG edge counts, block counts, and edge probabilities to satisfy flow conservation. Its responsibility is profile repair and normalization for CFG frequency data rather than branch prediction heuristics themselves.
